prose:
A Reuters item indexed by Techmeme reports Anthropic shares falling more than 8% to around $80, below the $83 IPO price, after an initial rise to $111.50. The feed also says Dario and Daniela Amodei each sold more than 3.37 million shares worth more than $280 million.

The Reuters article returned an access error, so these numbers are limited to the feed excerpt and should retain that attribution. They are a different intraday snapshot from the [MSN-carried market report](../summaries/929bc91ad356.md), not necessarily a contradiction or a closing price. The excerpt alone does not establish transaction timing, intent, future returns or causation for the selloff.
highlights: Reuters feed describes a fall below $83 IPO pricing
Around $80 is a reported intraday level
Share-sale figures come from the excerpt only
Different timestamps can explain different quoted prices
No motive or investment forecast is inferred
